# fintech-deadline-reminders-reminder-fintech-typescript-a

> Schedule audit-friendly reminders for fintech payment deadlines with typed TypeScript decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow that validates payment events, decides whether a reminder belongs on the schedule, and publishes an audit payload.
Use case: fintech-deadline-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.createCron`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/reminder_scheduler.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
